cohort: 200 antenatal women between 34 and 41 weeks gestation at Ram Manohar Lohia (RML) Hospital
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI < 5) was significantly correlated with an increased rate of cesarean section for fetal distress and low birth weight babies (<2.5 kg).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate for fetal distress was higher in patients with oligohydramnios.
birth_weight: recorded, specifically low birth weight (<2.5 kg)
